audience: Teenage and adult English learners, A2-B2; calm, welcoming professional setting.
core_action: Read, listen, speak and compose words; the scene supports focus without competing with the lesson.
composition: Paired development desks are central. A real mobile whiteboard and widescreen display form a rear review area. A smaller side desk with a laptop forms a quiet analysis nook. Preserve a clear foreground and consistent miniature perspective.
coordinate_policy: Source models are centered horizontally and grounded at their imported AABB minimum before the listed uniform scale/yaw/placement. Contact placements derive from actual parent bounds. Source origin offsets must not be treated as object centers.

room.note: Use acquired floor and wall modules, not box meshes or generated flat scene stand-ins. The larger footprint creates room for three distinct functions. Native composition may reduce visible blank floor through camera framing.

objects.note: Original framed panel, tray and casters remain intact. Face toward the room after actual imported orientation inspection. Do not add fake code, diagrams or text.
Check spacing against the central left chair and adjust only after real render; no usability-clearance certification.

camera.framing_requirement: Adjust camera framing after actual composition inspection. Keep paired monitors and a review-area cue in the central x=0.22..0.78, y=0.27..0.73 safe region where possible. These bounds conservatively anticipate full-square cover at the portrait/landscape extremes; use actual Main layer bounds for acceptance, not this estimate.

lighting.source_style: Reuse existing orthographic studio rendering language; preserve original object materials.
lighting.inspection: The current preview's near-white screens and wall highlights need separation. Adjust light exposure, not source tint or fake outline geometry, if the acquired whiteboard edge disappears. No flashing screen light or animated full-scene exposure.

layer_derivation.environment: 768x768 background plate containing source room, review display/cabinet, whiteboard and plant rest state.
layer_derivation.props: 768x768 transparent foreground layer for paired workstations, analysis nook and lamp, derived from identical camera/light captures with correct shadows and occlusion. Root may use the established exact-composition layer method from Retail/Nursing.
layer_derivation.home: Copy the accepted 512x320 Digital Studio Home PNG byte-for-byte; preserve the production preview separately.
layer_derivation.motion: Render the complete source composition at every leaf pose; derive a bounded local patch containing the union of every changed pixel, including any changed shadow and foreground occlusion. The final rest composite must match the accepted full rest render. Do not paste an isolated floating leaf over an incompatible shadow.
layer_derivation.runtime_file_policy: Only exact accepted PNGs become content-addressed professional-media sidecars. Original GLBs, licenses, HTML and source previews remain provenance and are excluded from runtime bundles.

ambient_motion.operation: Author a small local rotation of the existing separate leaf node around its rooted base; no mesh replacement, scaling, new leaves or pot motion.
ambient_motion.axis: local Z after imported source orientation/pivot inspection
ambient_motion.rect_binding: Derive from the actual union crop of accepted rendered frames divided by 768. Do not guess a shipping rect before rendering.
ambient_motion.availability: Newly authored rotation proposed from static acquired parts. No baked source animation or skin exists.
ambient_motion.acceptance: Inspect every pose, normal-speed eight-second loop and seam. Reduced motion holds frame zero; hidden view pauses; visible view resumes; leaving releases the sheet. Reject visible leaf detachment, pot rocking or edge shimmer.

budget.note: Planning ceiling, not a measured manifest. Root must bind exact rendered dimensions/hashes/bytes and validate 32 MiB per bundle, 10 MiB per module encoded and 128 MiB residency in actual complete manifests. Shared existing audio is not duplicated into these four image records.
